name: Summary columns
purpose: Puts a few short facts side by side, in equal columns with a divider between them: two statuses, such as a vehicle's tax and MOT; counts, such as a driver's offences and points; or details with icons, such as a vehicle's year, fuel and colour.

proposed.design: a screenshot of the future driving designs in Figma, shared by Shaun in November 2026, until there’s a link to the file

origin.notes: From the future driving designs in Figma, which we have only as a screenshot for now, so its sizes are approximate. The app today has nothing like it on iOS; Android draws a vehicle's year, fuel and colour with SpecificationsIcons.

inputs.content: Two to four <govuk-app-summary-column> elements, left to right. Each takes a value and a label, for a count, such as value="0" label="Offences"; or an icon, the name of a Material Symbol, and a label, for a detail, such as icon="calendar_month" label="2017". Without either, it holds what's written between its tags, such as a <govuk-app-status>.

rules: Use it for two to four facts of the same kind that are worth taking in at a glance. For more, or for longer ones, use a grouped list.
Keep each column to one kind: all counts, all details with icons, or all statuses.
Keep labels to a word or two, so they fit on a line in a narrow column.
Put it inside a card, such as a grouped list's section, with anything more about the facts, such as History, in a row below it.

android.symbol: SpecificationsIcons, a vehicle's year, fuel and colour today

other.title: Material Symbols, the icons it draws

examples.name: Two statuses
examples.html:
<govuk-app-summary-columns>
  <govuk-app-summary-column>
    <govuk-app-status label="Tax" caption="Valid"></govuk-app-status>
  </govuk-app-summary-column>
  <govuk-app-summary-column>
    <govuk-app-status state="due" progress="0.75" label="MOT due" caption="23 days"></govuk-app-status>
  </govuk-app-summary-column>
</govuk-app-summary-columns>
